CN Tower, Toronto Saturday Travis took me for a surprise dinner. He ended up driving me to Toronto and we ended up having dinner at the CN Tower. The tower is 1,815 feet tall and near the top there is a revolving restaurant. It was such an amazing view from up there! You could look out and see the lake with all the boats and you could see so much of Toronto all around. It was awesome to see the sunset too. After a fantastic meal we went down to the next floor and walked around and that is when Travis said beautiful things to me and then got down on one knee and proposed to me. 🙂 It is so exciting to know I am getting married and I feel so blessed that God has truly blessed me with such a wonderful man who loves me so much more then I would have ever imagined. He really is wonderful to me! It is neat to hear comments from different people saying they knew that we were meant to be. Neat how God spoke to them and told them that Travis was the perfect man for me. God has fulfilled desires of my heart and… the ring? Well it is everything I dreamed of. Travis had no clue what I wanted and yet what I got is exactly what I had wanted. It is just so cool how God works!
